name: Crypto Stonks
author: Walter Souto
description: A crypto futures watchlist for your Omarchy bar. Work in progress: today the pill shows BTCUSDT's move since 00:00 UTC as the day's line, an arrow, text, or a bull or a bear.

barWidget.description: Crypto futures prices in your bar.

schema.label: Pill
schema.description: How the pill looks in the centre or left section of a top or bottom bar. Middle-click the pill to change it.

schema.label: Pill on the right
schema.description: How the pill looks in the right section of a top or bottom bar, among the bar's icons. Middle-click the pill there to change it.

schema.label: Pill on a side bar
schema.description: How the pill looks on a bar at the side of the screen: the day's bull or bear, or the symbol over its change. Middle-click the pill there to switch.
